The Problem问题

Two Questions That Need Answers两个必须回答的质疑

"Just Prompt Engineering?""不就是 Prompt Engineering？"

AlphaEvolve: candidates in prompt, LLM edits, test, keep winners, repeat. Where's the theory?AlphaEvolve：候选放 prompt，LLM 改，跑测试，留好的，循环。理论在哪？

"Stochastic Parrot Problem""随机鹦鹉怎么想新东西？"

LLM trained on human text. How can the known produce the unknown?LLM 在人类文本上训练。已知怎么产出未知？

Image generation answered both in 2022. Nobody asks why Stable Diffusion creates unseen images. Same math applies here.图像生成在 2022 年已回答了这两个问题。没人再问 Stable Diffusion 为什么能生成不存在的图片。同样的数学适用于此。

Precedent先例

Image Generation Solved This in 2022图像生成在 2022 年解决了这个问题

  • THEOREM SD learns score function ∇ log p(x), not imagesSD 学到的是 score function ∇ log p(x)，不是图片本身
  • THEOREM Score defined between training samples (noise → full support)Score 在训练样本之间也有定义（噪声注入 → full support）
  • THEOREM CFG ω > 1 pushes sampling beyond training distributionCFG ω > 1 把采样推到训练分布之外

ANALOGY LLM discovery shares this structure: pre-training = score, context = transport, evaluator = guidance.LLM 发现共享相同结构：pre-training = score，context = transport，evaluator = guidance。

Why Same Structure为什么结构相同

Same Problem → Same Derivation同一个问题 → 同一个推导

Step步骤Image Generation图像生成Scientific Discovery科学发现
1 Direct sampling hits pdata with prob 0 (data on low-dim manifold in R196608)直接采样命中 pdata 概率为 0（数据在 R196608 的低维流形上） Single LLM call hits good idea with prob ε ≪ 1 (novel = long tail of pθ)单次 LLM 调用命中好 idea 概率 ε ≪ 1（新颖 = pθ 的长尾）
2 MCMC/Langevin: mixing time exponential in dim. Cannot cross low-density gaps.MCMC/Langevin：mixing time 随维度指数增长。无法跨越低密度区域。 Independent repeat: n ≈ 1/ε. For hard problems (ε=10-20), infeasible.独立重复：n ≈ 1/ε。困难问题（ε=10-20）物理上不可行。
3 Construct intermediate distributions pT → p0, each step small.构造中间分布序列 pT → p0，每步小修正。 Iteratively rewrite search distribution μ0 → μB, each step small.迭代重写搜索分布 μ0 → μB，每步小修正。
4 Need: score (direction), conditional transition, drift (selection), state (memory)需要：score（方向）、条件 transition、drift（选择）、state（记忆） Need: evaluator (direction), conditional generation, selection, memory需要：评估器（方向）、条件生成、选择、记忆

Not analogy by choice. Both face the same math problem: low-probability target in high-dimensional space under finite budget. The derivation is forced.不是刻意类比。两者面对同一个数学问题：高维空间中低概率目标的有限预算命中。推导是被迫一致的。

Key Insight关键洞察

The Dual Manifold Problem双流形问题

FM has one target: pdata. Discovery has two:FM 只有一个目标：pdata。Discovery 有两个：

Valid Ideas有效想法流形

Stay here. Correct, testable, well-formed.要留在上面。正确、可检验、结构完整。

Known Ideas已知想法流形

Leave here. Already published.要离开。已经发表。

Target = Valid ∩ ¬Known

ω=1 → known good. ω>1 → new territory. This is the Level 1/2 boundary.ω=1 → 已知好 idea。ω>1 → 新领域。这就是 Level 1/2 的边界。

Forward = Information LossForward = 信息丧失

good idea + full context + feedback + memory ↓ remove feedback good idea + rough context ↓ remove context good idea + empty context ↓ remove conditioning stochastic parrot = μ_0

Honest Limits诚实的边界

Where It Breaks类比在哪里断裂

  • Dual manifold: Valid∩¬Known vs just pdata. ω>1 bridges but proxy mismatch worsens.双流形： Valid∩¬Known vs 只需 pdata。ω>1 是桥梁但 proxy mismatch 加剧。
  • Discrete space: Tokens lack Euclidean interpolation. "Semantic smoothness" empirical, not proven.离散空间： Token 没有欧几里得插值。"语义平滑性"是经验观察，未证明。
  • Level 2: Paradigm shifts = non-Gaussian jumps. Framework boundary.Level 2： 范式转换 = 非高斯跳跃。框架边界。

Sufficient to import hypotheses, not to import theorems.足以 import 假设，不足以 import 定理。

Research Program研究路线

Analogy → Theorem: 3 Steps从类比到定理：3 步

  • Step 1 (Hard): Discrete score on tokens. Prove NTP = discrete SM.Token 空间上的 discrete score。证明 NTP = discrete SM。
  • Step 2 (Hard): Evaluator as likelihood p(ot|st,Rt). "Feedback to context" = Bayesian update.Evaluator 形式化为 likelihood p(ot|st,Rt)。"反馈写入 context" = Bayesian 更新。
  • Step 3 (Medium): Toy example: both sides computable. Verify or falsify.Toy example：两边都能算。验证或证伪。

If Step 1 works: [CONJECTURE] → [THEOREM]. If not: prescriptions still stand.Step 1 成功：[CONJECTURE] → [THEOREM]。失败：prescriptions 仍然独立成立。

Summary总结

Three Sentences三句话

LLM discovery loops share the structure of diffusion sampling: broad distribution → score-guided transport → target.LLM 发现循环与 diffusion 采样共享结构：宽分布 → score-guided transport → 目标。

This imports testable prescriptions: cosine curriculum, coarse-to-fine evaluator, βKL annealing.由此 import 可检验的训练处方：cosine 课程、先粗后细评估、βKL 退火。

Not proven yet. Generates experiments that can validate it.尚未证明。但生成了可验证的实验预测。

Next: cosine curriculum vs uniform in RLVR.下一步：在 RLVR 中跑 cosine curriculum vs uniform 的 ablation。
